
Templates let you define a parameterised SQL expression once and derive multiple
concept versions by supplying different parameter values.

## Setup

```{r}
library(conceptR)
library(duckdb)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb(), ":memory:")

bundle <- structure(
  list(
    object_types = list(
      list(id = "Person", table_name = "persons", primary_key = "person_id")
    )
  ),
  class = "ontology_bundle"
)

DBI::dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE TABLE persons (
    person_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    employed        INTEGER,
    available_work  INTEGER,
    seeking_work    INTEGER,
    ref_weeks       INTEGER
  )
")

set.seed(1)
for (i in 1:40) {
  DBI::dbExecute(con,
    "INSERT INTO persons VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
    params = list(paste0("P", i),
                  sample(0:1, 1), sample(0:1, 1), sample(0:1, 1),
                  sample(1:4, 1)))
}

ctx <- concept_context(bundle, con)
```

## Define an ILO unemployment template

```{r}
cpt_define_template(ctx, "ilo_unemployed", "Person",
  base_sql_expr = paste0(
    "employed = 0 AND available_work = 1 AND ",
    "seeking_work = 1 AND ref_weeks >= {{min_ref_weeks}}"
  ),
  parameters = list(
    min_ref_weeks = list(
      type        = "integer",
      default     = 1L,
      description = "Minimum reference period in weeks"
    )
  ),
  source_standard = "ILO-2013"
)
```

## Preview without committing

```{r}
cpt_render_template(ctx, "ilo_unemployed", list(min_ref_weeks = 2))
```

## Derive country variants

```{r}
cpt_inherit(ctx, "unemployed_ireland", "ilo_unemployed", "national",
  parameter_values = list(min_ref_weeks = 1L),
  rationale        = "CSO methodology: 1-week reference",
  status           = "active")

cpt_inherit(ctx, "unemployed_us", "ilo_unemployed", "national",
  parameter_values = list(min_ref_weeks = 4L),
  rationale        = "BLS methodology: 4-week reference",
  status           = "active")
```

## Compare variants

```{r}
cpt_compare_template_variants(ctx, "ilo_unemployed")
```

## List all templates

```{r}
cpt_list_templates(ctx)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```
